axiom_checks.note: Uninterpreted exact-target predicate from the trusted prelude. The exported theorem instantiates it only at exactC66BMTarget (g=6,n=6,homological degree 16,weight -16,tate 8). Reading reconstructed from ATT-0136 sections 0 and 8: W_{-16} H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(8), including rank zero. It is not a quotient, associated graded, support term, or differently indexed group.

If the cycle-class map surjects onto lowest weight and the group is polarizable of weight 2c, it is a finite Q(-c) sum. Instantiated only at OpenPureIndex M_{6,5} in degree/weight 24 with c=12, after CKgP. Algebraicity is a hypothesis, so there is no Tate-to-algebraic upgrade. Not applied at n=6.

Poincare duality identification of the BM target with the ordinary lowest-weight group, plus PureIsFiniteTateSum of that whole group, plus Q(t)(d)=Q(t+d), yields BMIsFiniteTateSum. Instantiated with d=21, t=-13, u=8 on exactC66BMTarget and pureM66deg26. Rank is unmentioned, so rank zero is allowed. Transports the whole group, not a subquotient.

CKgP on the open stack for markings <= c(g). With ckgp_marking_bound_genus_six this is n<=5 at genus 6. Used at moduliM65; the n=6 instance is not derivable and the model witness NC05 refutes CKgP at six markings.
Records c(6)=5 inclusively, matching THM-0005 / ATT-0136 section 7. Combined with ckgp_holds_in_range this is the zero-slack boundary used to type W_24 H^{24}(M_{6,5};Q), never M_{6,6}.

Optional CLP Lemma 3.1(a): the primitive quotient of lowest-weight open cohomology is a local-system sum with base degree k-n and partition size n. Instantiated at (6,6,26) as H^{20}(M_6;V_lambda) with |lambda|=6. Present only in the optional theorem closure; not load-bearing for the BM theorem.
Ordinary rational cohomology vanishes strictly above vcd. Used as H^{26}(M_{6,5};Q)=0 from vcd=25, which is ATT-0136 (4) and the slot-zero disposal. No inference from 26=vcd(M_{6,6}).

If lowest-weight restriction ClosedPureIndex -> OpenPureIndex surjects, the closed source splits by Chow-Kunneth, and every length-equal-to-factors Kunneth summand restricts into Psi of the open target, then the whole open target is ContainedInPsi. This is the containment direction of ATT-0136 section 1 plus section 5; kernel, Gysin, and Schur-Weyl are absent. Distinct types prevent an identity reading.
CKgP implies the cycle-class map surjects onto the lowest-weight piece of the same open space. Applied to pureM65deg24 after CKgP at n=5, supplying algebraicity before Tate type is read off.

Heterogeneous Deligne lowest-weight surjection W_k H^k(C^n) ->> W_k H^k(M_{g,n}) when genus matches, factors equal markings, degree and weight match, and degree=weight. This is Hodge II Cor. 3.2.17 / FND-0197. It does not split, does not identify kernels, and is not the non-proper forgetful map to M_g. Wrong-factor, wrong-marking, and wrong-degree instances fail the alignment hypotheses throughout, not only at the named constants sourceC6deg26 and pureM66deg26.

E2 degeneration for the smooth proper unmarked universal curve, g>=2. OBL-02 is respected: this flag alone does not yield KunnethSplittingByChowKunnethProjectors; the splitting axiom still demands algebraic PTY correspondences and the R^2 projector form.

Optional equality W=Psi from a vanishing primitive quotient and vanishing Phi. Used only to prove optional_primitive_route_equals_psi. The BM theorem never mentions EqualsPsi and instead uses ContainedInPsi from the Kunneth route.
vcd(PMod_{g,n})=4g-4+n for n>=1, g>=2. Instantiated at (6,5) as 25. Not applied as a vanishing statement at (6,6).
vcd(Mod_g)=4g-5 for unmarked g>=2. Instantiated at g=6 as 19, the Harer bound used for local-system vanishing of Kunneth base degrees.

Actual mixed-Hodge splitting of W_k H^k(C^n) into A_i, requiring E2 degeneration, algebraic PTY correspondences, and the explicit R^2 projector, on ClosedPureIndex only, with unmarked base of matching genus, at least one factor, and lowest weight. OpenPureIndex cannot inhabit this predicate. E2 degeneration is not treated as sufficient.

Kunneth summand A_i of the closed source vanishes when every rational local system on unmarked M_g vanishes in degree k-|i|, with |i| the sum of slotVal in {0,1,2}. At (6,6,26) this is 26-|i|>19, i.e. |i|<=6. Indices and variance match ATT-0136 section 5.

Every finite-dimensional rational local system on unmarked M_g vanishes strictly above vcd. Used in the BM theorem at base degrees >=20 and reused, legitimately, by the optional primitive-quotient route at degree 20. Not smuggled as a Tate-type input.

Lowest-weight cohomology of the smooth open stack is pure polarizable. Used at (6,5,24) for CKgP typing and at (6,6,26) for the semisimplicity upgrade of the whole group. Matches FND-0033 as used in ATT-0136 sections 7-8.

Rational Morita vanishing H^1(Mod_g;H^1(Sigma_g;Q))=0 for g>=2, disposing the slot-one summand b_s of omega_s. Feeds OmegaMultiplicationHitsSlotTwo together with the slot decomposition and the R^2 projector, matching ATT-0136 Disposal A as a written step.
omega_s=a_s+b_s+c_s in slots 0,1,2, with only c_s the R^2 isomorphism. This is the FND-0196 inhomogeneity; multiplication by omega is not identified with its R^2 component without the repair.

From the slot decomposition, Morita vanishing of b_s, and the R^2 projector in the psi-plus-pullback span, cup-product with omega reaches slot two modulo the tracked slot-zero and slot-one errors. This is the packaged content of Disposals A and B, then consumed by the OBL-05 induction (Disposal C). Premises are those ATT-0136 actually uses; the conclusion is not the Tate type of M_{6,6}.

Definition of Phi as the span of forgetful pullbacks from n-1 in the same degree and weight. Used at (6,6)->(6,5) in degrees 26 and 24. Does not rename the mixed R^1 of the punctured forgetful map as a local system on M_g.

Forgetful pullbacks preserve Tate type, so Phi_{6,6}^{24} inherits Q(-12) from W_24 H^{24}(M_{6,5};Q). Type (0,0) pullback as in ATT-0136 section 7. Does not type Phi^{26} or the n=6 lowest-weight group by itself.

Phi vanishes when the n-1 ordinary cohomology in the same degree vanishes. Campaign-declared optional: used only to feed the optional W=Psi equality. The BM path instead uses OrdinaryCohomologyVanishes at (M_{6,5},26) directly as the slot-zero disposal, which is the same ATT-0136 vanishing and does not leak this axiom into the exported theorem.

Stack-level rational Poincare duality: d=3g-3+n, ordinary degree 2d minus BM degree, ordinary weight equals that degree, BM weight equals ordinary weight minus 2d. Instantiated as d=21, ordinary (26,26), BM weight -16. Encodes the identification of groups, not Tate type. No coarse-space or compactly-supported Q(-8) substitute.

If the whole lowest-weight open group is contained in Psi, is polarizable, and Psi is a quotient of a finite Tate sum of type t, then the whole group is a finite Tate sum of type t. Distinct predicates prevent treating a Psi-quotient as already the theorem. Semisimplicity of polarizable pure Q-Hodge structures (FND-0033 at weight 26) upgrades a subobject of a Tate quotient to an honest direct sum, not a semisimplification of a mixed object. ContainedInPsi is the Kunneth-route generation statement, not the optional EqualsPsi.
Optional: if the primitive quotient is a local-system sum and H^{k-n}(M_g;V)=0, the quotient vanishes. At (6,6,26) this is H^{20}(M_6;V_lambda)=0 from 20>19. Absent from the BM axiom closure.
The tautological psi class on an n>=1 open moduli space is algebraic of type Q(-1). Matches ATT-0136 dictionary and section 7. Does not assert algebraicity of W_26 H^{26}(M_{6,6}).

Definition of Psi as psi times the same-space group two degrees and two weights lower. Used both in the OBL-05 induction (omega/B_{i'} lands in Psi) and in the OBL-08 Tate assembly. Mapping to OBL-04 is the definitional slot; the reading is the ATT-0136 Psi dictionary, not a hidden vanishing.

Psi, being generated by Q(-1) cup Phi of type Q(-12), is a quotient of a finite Q(-13) sum. Concludes PsiIsQuotientOfFiniteTateSum, not PureIsFiniteTateSum, so the whole-group statement still needs containment plus polarizable semisimplicity. Twist arithmetic t=a+b is explicit.

Petersen-Tavakol-Yin relative Chow-Kunneth projectors are algebraic correspondences, hence morphisms of mixed Hodge structures, so W_k is additive over the splitting. Required for an actual splitting rather than an associated-graded decomposition.

The R^2 projector is pi_2 = psi_2/(2g-2) - kappa_1/(2(2g-2)^2), already in the Q-span of a psi class and a pullback from M_g. This is ATT-0136 section 2 / Disposal B. It is a hypothesis of the closed-source splitting and of omega-hits-slot-two, not a conclusion about the open target.

One downward-induction step at the campaign point. Hypotheses: slots = pre ++ [2] ++ post; errZero / errOne are the syntactic resets to 0 and 1 on the same closed source; OmegaMultiplicationHitsSlotTwo on M_6; alignment of the closed source with the open target; Psi spanned by the degree-2-lower open group; that group spanned by forgetful pullbacks from n-1; H^{tgt.degree}(M_{g,n-1})=0; and KunnethSummandRestrictsIntoPsi of errOne. Slot-one is disposed by the strictly smaller total (reset 2 to 1 decreases |i| by 1). Slot-zero is disposed by ordinary vanishing in the original degree on n-1, matching ATT-0136 (restriction of A_{i'} through W_k H^k(M_{g,n-1})=0), not by inducting on errZero. errZero is only a slot-pattern witness, which is not unused-premise laundering of a stronger statement. The omega/B_{i'} landing in Psi is the open Psi/Phi spanning at degrees k and k-2, packaging the closed degree-(k-2) class B_{i'} as in Disposal C. Premises are exactly those of ATT-0136 section 5.
Q(a)(b)=Q(a+b). Instantiated as (-13)+21=8, converting the ordinary Q(-13) statement into the BM Q(8) statement. Purely the Tate-twist dictionary of ATT-0136 section 0.

A vanishing closed Kunneth summand restricts into Psi of an aligned open target (zero lies in every subspace). Used as the |i|<=6 base of the induction after Harer vanishing. Alignment again uses distinct closed/open types and factors=markings.

Uninterpreted C66Vocabulary whose type is the hash-pinned shared signature. It is a carrier of predicates, not a hidden proof of the BM conclusion. EqualsPsi, PrimitiveQuotientIsLocalSystemSum, PrimitiveQuotientVanishes, and PhiVanishes are fields of this structure but are never applied on the BM path, so OBL-06 is not concealed inside vocab.

axiom_faithfulness: Every LEAN-AXIOM was reconstructed from ATT-0136 (REV-0187/REV-0188 used only as prior confirmation of that source proof). OBL-01 is a heterogeneous ClosedPureIndex-to-OpenPureIndex lowest-weight surjection plus transfer of containment; it does not split and does not use M_{g,n}->M_g. OBL-02 requires algebraic PTY correspondences and the explicit R^2 projector in addition to E2 degeneration, and the splitting predicate is typed only on ClosedPureIndex. OBL-03 records omega_s=a_s+b_s+c_s, Morita vanishing of b_s, and omega-hits-slot-two modulo errors rather than identifying omega with its R^2 component. OBL-04 is H^{26}(M_{6,5};Q)=0 from vcd(PMod_{6,5})=25, used as Phi's source vanishing and as the slot-zero disposal; the named PhiVanishes packaging is optional and does not leak. OBL-05 is a genuine six-slot List Slot induction: lenOf=6=factors, base |i|<=6 from 26-|i|>=20>19, combinatorics that a length-6 list with total>6 contains a 2, strict fuel decrease when resetting 2 to 1, slot-one by IH, slot-zero by the ATT-0136 vanishing, not by a fake identity. OBL-06 is independently printed and is absent from the BM closure (the four campaign-declared optional names clp_primitive_quotient_formula, phi_vanishes_from_pullback_source, primitive_quotient_vanishes_from_local_coefficients, equality_from_vanishing_primitive_quotient_and_phi occur in optional_primitive_route_equals_psi and not in c66_exact_bm_is_finite_tate_sum; they are not hidden through vocab). OBL-07 types W_24 H^{24}(M_{6,5}) as Q(-12) by CKgP at n=5=c(6) on the open stack, never at n=6. OBL-08 assembles Psi as a Q(-13) quotient from psi of type Q(-1) and Phi of type Q(-12), then upgrades the whole contained polarizable group. OBL-09 is duality in dimension 21 with Q(-13)(21)=Q(8). No strengthened premises, weakened conclusions, circular carriers, wrong variance, or unused-premise laundering were found.
model_faithfulness: Claim.lean and Model.lean embed the same C66Vocabulary region as formal/C66SeparatedSignature.lean.inc (hash 0456ade3127aa74d77118951addcae1c151feb7e86600cf3ca04123e6a5a4126); BMTargetIndex in Claim matches formal/TrustedC66Target.lean.inc. modelVocabulary is a single concrete instance of that signature, not a second vocabulary. AX01-AX34 are the 34 mathematical Claim axiom schemas and are all proved; BMIsFiniteTateSum and vocab are interpreted rather than assumed. The model witness depends only on Lean core axioms propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. Non-collapse is material for the repaired boundary: ClosedPureIndex and OpenPureIndex are disjoint types, so the closed source cannot inhabit open-only predicates and the open target cannot inhabit KunnethSplittingByChowKunnethProjectors or KunnethIndex.source; RestrictionSurjectsOnLowestWeight is a heterogeneous relation requiring genus, factors=markings, degree, weight, and lowest weight, so it cannot be identity-on-indices; NC02 shows a five-factor source does not restrict to the six-marking target; NC03/NC04 distinguish off-diagonal and wrong Tate index; NC05 fails CKgP at n=6; NC06 fails local-system vanishing at the vcd threshold rather than strictly above; NC08/NC09 fail the wrong BM Tate index and the wrong duality dimension. Restriction, Kunneth source, open target, Psi-containment versus off-diagonal, and the Tate/duality numerical conclusions are therefore distinguished. Remaining arithmetic proxies (ContainedInPsi as degree=weight, PureIsFiniteTateSum as weight+2t=0, KunnethSummandRestrictsIntoPsi as aligned plus vanishes-or-hasTwo) make some generation axioms slack in the model, but they do not re-identify the closed fibre power with the open stack or make every predicate true, and EqualsPsi remains a strictly stronger vcd test than ContainedInPsi.
statement_faithfulness: The exported theorem is c66_exact_bm_is_finite_tate_sum : BMIsFiniteTateSum exactC66BMTarget. The trusted prelude pins exactC66BMTarget to genus 6, markings 6, homological degree 16, weight -16, Tate index 8, which is C66-EXACT-TARGET-V1 and ATT-0136's exact group W_{-16} H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q). The ordinary form appears only through an explicit duality step: poincare_duality_bm_twist with d=3*6-3+6=21 identifies that BM group with W_26 H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21), ordinaryTate is PureIsFiniteTateSum of OpenPureIndex (M_{6,6}, degree 26, weight 26) with t=-13, and tate_twist_shift_add gives Q(-13)(21)=Q(8). Coefficients remain the rational MHS setting of the source; no coarse-space object is introduced. Rank is unconstrained, so the empty sum is allowed. The theorem is not about a quotient, associated graded, support term, or a differently indexed group: polarizable_semisimplicity_upgrade concludes PureIsFiniteTateSum of the same open index that ContainedInPsi concerns, then duality transports that whole group.
strongest_attack: The strongest attack is an identity-on-indices / fibre-power-equals-open-stack reading: if ClosedPureIndex were secretly the same carrier as OpenPureIndex, restriction could be reflexivity and Kunneth could run on M_{6,6}. Outcome: the types are disjoint in every axiom and lemma, not merely at the names sourceC6deg26 and pureM66deg26; RestrictionSurjectsOnLowestWeight demands genus, factor/marking, degree and weight alignment plus lowest weight; a type-correct five-factor source fails restriction to the six-marking target; wrong-degree and wrong-marking instances fail the same alignment; KunnethIndex.source and KunnethSplittingByChowKunnethProjectors accept only ClosedPureIndex. Second attack: OBL-06 smuggled through vocab or a shared axiom into the exported theorem. Outcome: the four campaign-declared optional axiom names are absent from c66_exact_bm_is_finite_tate_sum and present in optional_primitive_route_equals_psi; EqualsPsi and the primitive-quotient predicates are unused on the BM path; the BM theorem uses ContainedInPsi from the six-slot induction. Third attack: fake induction (wrong slot count, non-strict decrease, undisposed errors). Outcome: Lean proves lenOf=6, |i|<=6 vanishing from 26-|i|>=20>19, existence of a 2 when length<total, fuel drop by 1 on resetting 2 to 1, slot-one by IH, slot-zero by H^{26}(M_{6,5})=0, all ATT-0136 premises. Fourth attack: cosmetic arithmetic model collapsing Psi and Tate to lowest-weight numerics. Outcome: those interpretations are arithmetic and some generation axioms are slack, but the type distinction, 5-versus-6 restriction failure, CKgP boundary, strict vcd, wrong Tate index, and wrong duality dimension remain material failed instances, so the model is a consistency witness of the shared signature rather than a collapse of the repaired carriers.
